visualCharacteristics.purpose: notice panel with an icon/image panel beside a heading, text and links (e.g. PDS / policy booklet notices, annual report link)

contentPattern.structure: one row per callout; cells: [icon or image (optional)] [heading, text, links; or a /fragments/ link] [action link (optional)]. A single link makes the whole panel clickable with a chevron; with the button option the last link renders as a button

reuseGuidance: Use for highlighted notices pointing to documents or further reading. Options: image (icon panel), light (light bordered panel), button (link as button), image-light / image-light-2 (light panel with inline icon).
